title: [RPG Design Guides] Battle Balance ② Setting Up Basic Enemies

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】戦闘バランス② ザコ敵の設定
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] Battle Balance ② Setting Up Basic Enemies

blocks.source: 敵には、通常のエンカウントで戦う『ザコ敵』と、イベント上で戦う『ボス敵』の２種類が存在する。まずはザコ敵を先に解説する。
blocks.translation: There are two types of enemies: “basic enemies,” fought in normal encounters, and “boss enemies,” fought as part of events. I’ll start by explaining basic enemies.

blocks.source: ザコ敵の強さを決める前に、まずボス敵との役割の違いを考えてみよう。
blocks.translation: Before deciding how strong basic enemies should be, let’s first consider how their role differs from that of boss enemies.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ以降のＲＰＧには、ダンジョンごとにボスが存在する作品が多い。その場合は強敵としての役割はボス敵に任せてしまって、
blocks.translation: Many RPGs since the Super Famicom era have a boss for each dungeon. In such cases, it is fine to leave the role of powerful opponents to the bosses and make basic enemies somewhat weak, treating them as “hunting targets” and “stress relief targets.”

blocks.source: ザコ敵は「狩りの対象」「ストレス解消の対象」として、やや弱めでも問題ない。
blocks.translation: It is fine for basic enemies to be somewhat weak, treating them as “hunting targets” and “stress relief targets.”

blocks.source: ずばり、クリアまでに一度もザコ敵に全滅させられることがないような強さでも構わないだろう。
blocks.translation: In short, it is perfectly acceptable to make them weak enough that the player is never wiped out by basic enemies before clearing the game. If the basic battles that account for most of an RPG’s playtime are easy, the game’s tempo becomes faster and more comfortable. In exchange, making the bosses strong prevents the game from feeling like it lacks substance or has a low difficulty level.

blocks.source: ＲＰＧのプレイ時間の大半を占めるザコ戦が簡単だと、ゲームテンポが速くなるので快適である。その代わりに、ボス敵を強くしておけば「手応えがない」「難易度が低い」という印象もなくなる。
blocks.translation: If the basic battles that account for most of an RPG’s playtime are easy, the game’s tempo becomes faster and more comfortable. In exchange, making the bosses strong prevents the game from feeling like it lacks substance or has a low difficulty level.

blocks.source: テンポの良さと、手応えを両立できるという点で、僕のお勧めのバランスである。
blocks.translation: This is my recommended balance because it achieves both a brisk pace and satisfying battles.

blocks.source: ボス強ザコ弱ゲームバランスの成功例といえば、ロマンシングサガ３が有名。どこでもセーブが可能であり、戦闘終了後はＨＰが全快するシステムでありながら、ザコ戦では全滅どころか、HPが０にされることすら珍しい。
blocks.translation: Romancing SaGa 3 is a famous example of successful game balance with strong bosses and weak basic enemies. Although the game allows you to save anywhere and fully restores HP after battle, it is rare for a basic battle to even reduce your HP to 0, let alone wipe out the party.

blocks.source: しかし、ボス敵がしっかりと強いため、このゲームに対して手応えがないという不満を聞くことはあまりない。
blocks.translation: However, because the bosses are suitably strong, you rarely hear complaints that the game lacks substance.

blocks.source: もっとも、上記の方法はあくまでもお勧めに過ぎない。少し調整が難しくなるがザコ敵に全滅させられるような、緊張感あるバランスの面白さも否定できない。その場合も「エンカウント率を下げる」「全滅時のリスクを下げる」などして、快適性には気をつけよう。
blocks.translation: That said, the method above is only a recommendation. A tense balance in which basic enemies can wipe out the party can also be fun, although it is somewhat more difficult to tune. Even in that case, be mindful of comfort by doing things such as lowering the encounter rate and reducing the risks of a party wipe.

blocks.source: ただし、ザコ敵がボス敵の役割を奪わないよう注意したい。
blocks.translation: However, be careful not to let basic enemies take over the role of boss enemies.

blocks.source: 例えば、ＦＦシリーズのラストダンジョンのザコ敵は凶悪に強い傾向があるが、それに合わせてプレイヤーがパーティを鍛えすぎると、ラスボスが弱くてガッカリする羽目になる。
blocks.translation: For example, basic enemies in the final dungeons of the Final Fantasy series tend to be viciously strong. However, if players overtrain their party to match them, they may end up disappointed because the final boss is weak.

blocks.source: ボスを引き立てるために、ザコの強さを抑えるのも重要なテクニックである。
blocks.translation: Keeping basic enemies’ strength under control to make the boss stand out is also an important technique.

blocks.source: ＤＱ１～３のように行動の自由度が高いＲＰＧならば、
blocks.translation: In an RPG with a high degree of freedom, such as Dragon Quest I–III,

blocks.source: ザコ敵の強さで、プレイヤーの行き先を制限することができる。
blocks.translation: you can restrict where players can go through the strength of basic enemies.

blocks.source: ゲームデザイン次第では、極めて有効な手法となるので、ぜひ覚えておきたい。
blocks.translation: Depending on the game design, this can be an extremely effective method, so be sure to keep it in mind.

blocks.source: ザコ戦闘の長さは大体１～３ターン程度で決着が付くことを目安にすると良い。ザコ戦闘があまりに長引くＲＰＧは疲れてしまうからだ。これはエンカウント率を低めにするのと同じで、ゲームの快適性を高めることが目的。
blocks.translation: It is best to aim for basic battles to end in roughly one to three turns. RPGs in which basic battles drag on too long become tiring. Like lowering the encounter rate, this is intended to make the game more comfortable to play.

blocks.source: 同様の理由でザコ敵が同時に５～１０体以上の様に、大量に出現するのも戦闘が無意味に長引く要因になる。（変化を付ける意味でたまにやるくらいならば構わない。）ザコ敵を強くしたいのならば、ＨＰを上げて戦闘を長引かせるのではなく、攻撃を激しくすると適度に緊張感が生まれてよい。
blocks.translation: For the same reason, having large numbers of basic enemies appear at once—five to ten or more, for example—can cause battles to drag on pointlessly. (It is fine to do this occasionally for variety.) If you want to make basic enemies stronger, do not increase their HP and prolong the battle; making their attacks more aggressive creates an appropriate sense of tension.

blocks.source: もう一つ、ザコ戦闘でプレイヤーを不快にさせないための注意点として、ザコ敵の素早さを高くし過ぎないことが挙げられる。
blocks.translation: Another point to keep in mind to avoid making players uncomfortable during basic battles is not to make basic enemies too fast.

blocks.source: 例えば、戦闘システムがＣＴＢ（ＦＦ１０など）の作品にて、敵の中に攻撃力が高くて厄介な相手がいたとする。ここで味方の方が敵より素早さが高い状況なら、以下のような選択肢を取ることができる。
blocks.translation: For example, suppose a game uses a CTB battle system, such as Final Fantasy X, and one of the enemies is troublesome because of its high attack power. If the party is faster than the enemies, the player can choose from options such as the following.

blocks.source: 逃げる。
blocks.translation: Run away.

blocks.source: 集中攻撃して倒す。
blocks.translation: Focus your attacks and defeat it.

blocks.source: 眠らせるなど、状態異常で動きを封じる。
blocks.translation: Put it to sleep or otherwise disable it with a status ailment.

blocks.source: 打たれ弱いキャラに防御させる。あるいは防御を上昇させる魔法をかける。
blocks.translation: Have a frail character guard, or cast a spell that raises their Defense.

blocks.source: 逆にザコ敵の素早さが味方側より高い場合、プレイヤーが行動を起こす前に一方的に攻撃されてしまう。こうなると、プレイヤー側は何の戦術も取ることができない。当然プレイヤーに取っては面白くない状況である。
blocks.translation: Conversely, if basic enemies are faster than the party, they can attack unilaterally before the player has a chance to act. When this happens, the player has no tactical options at all. Naturally, this is not an enjoyable situation for the player.

blocks.source: ※ＤＱを始めとしたターン制ならば、素早さで負けていても大抵は『逃げる』と『防御』の行動は取れるようになっている。それでも、やはり戦略は制限されるけれど……。
blocks.translation: ※In turn-based systems such as Dragon Quest, you can usually still choose “Escape” and “Guard” even when you are slower than the enemies. Even so, your strategic options are still limited…

blocks.source: 目安としては……
blocks.translation: As a general guideline…

blocks.source: 敵の素早さが標準的な場合、パーティ人数の半分より上の人数。（例：３人パーティなら２人）
blocks.translation: When the enemies have average Agility, more than half the party should be faster. (For example, two members in a three-person party.)

blocks.source: 敵の素早さが高い場合、最低１人。
blocks.translation: When the enemies have high Agility, at least one member should be faster.

blocks.source: の味方が敵より先に動けることが望ましい。装備など、素早さを補強できる手段を設けて、プレイヤー側で対策できる様にするのも有効だ。
blocks.translation: It is preferable for this many party members to be able to act before the enemies. It is also effective to provide ways for the player to counter this, such as equipment that boosts Agility.

blocks.source: ザコ戦闘を楽しくするためには、敵にわかりやすい個性を付けるのも有効である。
blocks.translation: Giving enemies clear, recognizable characteristics is another effective way to make basic battles more enjoyable.

blocks.source: 例えば……
blocks.translation: For example…

blocks.source: 力が強い敵
blocks.translation: Enemies with great strength

blocks.source: 固い敵
blocks.translation: Tough enemies

blocks.source: 魔法が得意な敵
blocks.translation: Enemies skilled with magic

blocks.source: 状態異常を多用する嫌な敵
blocks.translation: Annoying enemies that frequently use status ailments

blocks.source: １体で出現する巨大モンスター
blocks.translation: A giant monster that appears alone

blocks.source: 魔法しか効かない敵
blocks.translation: Enemies vulnerable only to magic

blocks.source: 魔法を反射する敵
blocks.translation: Enemies that reflect magic

blocks.source: これによって、力が強い敵ならば、味方の守備力を上げる魔法を使う。固い敵ならば、敵の守備力を下げる魔法を使う。または魔法で攻撃する。単体で出現する巨大モンスターならば、補助魔法で味方を強化しながら慎重に戦う。――と言うように、
blocks.translation: This means that against a strong enemy, you use a spell that raises your allies’ Defense. Against a tough enemy, you use a spell that lowers its Defense, or attack with magic. Against a giant monster that appears alone, you fight cautiously while strengthening your allies with support magic—in this way,

blocks.source: 敵に合わせて戦略を立てる必要があるため、戦闘に飽きにくくなる。
blocks.translation: because you need to devise strategies suited to each enemy, battles are less likely to become monotonous.

blocks.source: 市販ＲＰＧではＤＱ４が、面白いザコ敵を用意しているので参考にしてみよう。
blocks.translation: Among commercial RPGs, Dragon Quest IV provides some interesting basic enemies, so try using it as a reference.

blocks.source: ＨＰが減ると、目の色が変わり痛恨を繰り出す『大目玉』
blocks.translation: “Big Eye,” whose eyes change color and which unleashes a critical hit when its HP decreases

blocks.source: 戦闘が始まった瞬間から眠っていることがある『暴れ牛鳥』
blocks.translation: “Mad Bull Bird,” which may already be asleep when the battle begins

blocks.source: 物理攻撃を当てると、分裂する『メラゴースト』
blocks.translation: “Mera Ghost,” which splits when hit by a physical attack

blocks.source: ２体揃うと、強力な特技を繰り出す『マンルースター』
blocks.translation: “Man Rooster,” which unleashes a powerful Tech when two of them are together

blocks.source: （ＰＳ版では使わなくなった。残念……。）
blocks.translation: (It was no longer used in the PlayStation version. What a shame…)

blocks.source: ８体揃ったスライムが合体する『キングスライム』
blocks.translation: “King Slime,” formed when eight Slimes merge

blocks.source: ここまで個性を強化すると見ているだけでも退屈しない。
blocks.translation: When you strengthen their individuality this much, they are not boring even to watch.

blocks.source: このように戦闘を楽しくするのは、簡単だとか難しいだとかの難易度面だけではない。あくまで大切なのはプレイヤーを楽しませようという気持ちなのだ。
blocks.translation: Making battles fun like this is not just about difficulty—whether they are easy or hard. What matters most is the desire to entertain the player.
